system.description: The earth in a 20' radius around you becomes holy, repelling the dark. Sustained. Moving ends the spell.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, but the radius is 30'.
outcomes.success: Allies standing in the area defend with -2 DR. An Undead or Fiend that enters the area or starts its turn inside takes d6 radiant damage.
outcomes.failure: The ground holds only until the end of your next turn, and cannot be sustained.
outcomes.ruin: The ground rejects you: you are knocked Prone. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
